RIVER MUSIC SCHOOL UK Private Music Lessons in the United Kingdom Welcome to River Music School! River Music School offers one-to-one and small group music lessons for instruments, music theory, composition and song writing across Birmingham, Bristol, Liverpool and Manchester. Adults and children are welcome , from beginner to advanced , and our friendly, talented music tutors have heaps of knowledge to share with an unmatched enthusiasm for teaching . We collaborate with institutions including Ronnie Scott's Jazz Club, Rose Morris Denmark Street and others to create the best opportunities for our students. ​ If you are looking to start playing music, or are already a music student who is looking to improve their musicianship, you should look no further. Our philosophy is simple: music is like a river, let it flow within you!
